gate_results.rationale: Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_PROCUREMENT (v1, age 0d) shows selected vendor Fluxbridge Labs C2D29-4 with mandatory_criteria_failed=0, sanctions=clear, due_diligence=complete, and references_checked=false. Applying the DGF-decision-v8 procurement rule: no mandatory-criteria failure (PROC-MAND-001 not triggered), no sanctions hit or pending (PROC-SAN-001/002 not triggered), due diligence complete (PROC-DD-001 not triggered), and TCO 3y EUR 2,351,128 is well within the purchasing envelope (7,000,000 x 1.5 = 10,500,000; PROC-BUDGET-001 not triggered). Only PROC-REF-001 (medium, references not checked) applies, carrying disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS with action CHECK_VENDOR_REFERENCES. Corroborated by authoritative DUE_DILIGENCE (references_checked=False for Fluxbridge) and non-authoritative SCORING_MATRIX/VENDOR_OFFERS/PRICING_TCO, which agree with the snapshot. Conditional approval for this risk-acceptable finding was recorded under standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-01-PROCUREMENT-1 (authority Thomas Haddad-12002-RO, scope: all and only risk-acceptable findings), with conditions to complete reference checks before award and escalate any adverse reference to the risk owner. Authorization is required for GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS and is satisfied by the active standing mandate.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL (v1, age 0d) for MSA-C2D29-10.9 triggers exactly two findings under DGF-decision-v8. (1) LEGAL-AUDIT-001 (high, REWORK): audit_right="reports_only", corroborated by MSA §7 and the authoritative CONTRACT_PLAYBOOK requiring "full or limited"; action REDLINE_AUDIT_RIGHT. (2) LEGAL-SIGN-001 (critical, SUSPENSION): signing_authority_valid=false, corroborated by authoritative contract metadata for MSA-C2D29-10.9 and the playbook requirement signing_authority="valid"; action OBTAIN_AUTHORIZED_SIGNATORY. All other predicates fail to trigger: personal_data=false so no DPA required (LEGAL-DPA-001); liability_cap_multiplier="unlimited" (LEGAL-LIAB-001); exit_assistance_days=60 ≥ playbook minimum 30 (LEGAL-EXIT-001); ip_ownership="customer" (LEGAL-IP-001); insurance_valid=true (LEGAL-INS-001); log_export_clause="included" (LEGAL-LOG-001) — the non-authoritative MSA §6 stating "missing" is superseded by the authoritative snapshot and contract metadata per source precedence. Highest-severity disposition is SUSPENSION from the critical signing-authority finding. Authorization is required for SUSPENSION; the active standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-02-LEGAL-1 (Thomas Haddad-12002-RO) is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings" and cannot cover LEGAL-SIGN-001 (risk_acceptance_allowed=false), so no conditional approval is recorded and the gate is suspended pending an authorized signatory and audit-right redline.

gate_results.rationale: Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE (v1, age 0d) triggers exactly two findings under DGF-decision-v8. (2) COMP-EXPORT-002 (high, SUSPENSION): export_control="pending" (not "restricted", so COMP-EXPORT-001 does not trigger); action COMPLETE_EXPORT_CONTROL_REVIEW. All other predicates fail to trigger: dpia_required=false with dpia_status="not_required" (COMP-DPIA-001), audit_trail="partial" not "missing" (COMP-AUDIT-001), regulatory_mapping="partial" not "missing" (COMP-MAP-001), accessibility_status="pass" (COMP-A11Y-001). Highest-severity disposition is NO_GO from the critical residency violation. Authorization is required for NO_GO; the active standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-03-COMPLIANCE-1 (Thomas Haddad-12002-RO) is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings" and cannot cover COMP-RESID-001 or COMP-EXPORT-002 (both risk_acceptance_allowed=false), so no conditional approval is recorded and the gate is blocked pending data relocation or a valid residency basis and completion of export-control screening.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY (v1, age 0d) triggers exactly two findings under DGF-decision-v8. (1) SEC-NET-001 (critical, NO_GO): data_classification="Confidential" with private_endpoints=false, corroborated by authoritative AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH showing "private_endpoints": false and data-tier services (Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Storage Account, Azure Key Vault) all with "publicNetworkAccess": true — sensitive data services are reachable without private endpoints; action ENABLE_PRIVATE_ENDPOINTS (owner Cloud Platform). (2) SEC-VULN-001 (critical, NO_GO): critical_vulns_open=1, corroborated by authoritative VULN_SCAN showing CVE-2026-8000 severity Critical status Open; action REMEDIATE_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITIES (owner Product Team). All other predicates fail to trigger: WAF present in Prevention mode (WAF_POLICY: "present": true, "mode": "Prevention") so SEC-WAF-001/002 do not apply; mfa="mandatory" (SEC-IAM-001); shared_service_principal=false (SEC-IAM-002); logs_to_siem=true with sentinel=true (SEC-LOG-001); phase is design not build_acceptance and pentest_status="pass" (SEC-PENTEST-001); key_rotation_days=60 not None/365 (SEC-KEY-001). Highest-severity disposition is NO_GO from the two critical findings. Authorization is required for NO_GO; the active standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-04-SECURITY-1 (Thomas Haddad-12002-RO) is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings" and cannot cover SEC-NET-001 or SEC-VULN-001 (both risk_acceptance_allowed=false), so no conditional approval is recorded and the gate is blocked pending private endpoints for the Confidential data tier and remediation of the open critical vulnerability.

gate_results.rationale: Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT (v1, age 0d) at phase build_acceptance triggers exactly three findings under DGF-decision-v8. (1) IT-CMDB-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): cmdb_record_present=false, corroborated by authoritative CMDB_EXPORT showing record_present="False" for Project Raven — Payments API Hub [C2D29] and non-authoritative SUPPORT_RACI stating "CMDB required | Yes"; action CREATE_CMDB_RECORD (ITSM). (2) IT-EOL-001 (high, REWORK): technology_eol_months=4 < 12, corroborated by authoritative LIFECYCLE_REGISTER showing eol_months="4" for technology container_apps; action CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN (Technology Owner). (3) IT-CAPACITY-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): capacity_headroom_pct=8 < 15, corroborated by authoritative LIFECYCLE_REGISTER capacity_headroom_pct="8"; action INCREASE_CAPACITY_HEADROOM (Platform Operations). All other predicates fail to trigger: catalog_status="standard" with waiver_present=true and waiver_expiry_days=180 (IT-CATALOG-001; corroborated by authoritative TECH_CATALOG v5), duplicate_capability=false (IT-RATIONAL-001), license_compliant=true (IT-LICENSE-001; corroborated by authoritative LICENSE_POSITION v5), run_owner_present=true (IT-RUN-001; corroborated by SUPPORT_RACI run owner Amira Nguyen-12002-SO), and change_record_status="draft" does not trigger IT-CHANGE-001 because the phase predicate requires deployment_closure, not build_acceptance. Highest-severity disposition is REWORK from the high-severity IT-EOL-001. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO), so authorization_required=false; the active standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-05-IT-1 (Thomas Haddad-12002-RO, scoped to risk-acceptable findings) is not invoked because the gate outcome requires remediation, not risk acceptance. Note: authoritative CAPACITY_REPORT is UNAVAILABLE (age 147d); a request was recorded and the capacity value is corroborated by authoritative LIFECYCLE_REGISTER, so IT-CAPACITY-001 is supported on the submitted snapshot.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL (v1, age 0d) at phase governance triggers exactly two findings under DGF-decision-v8. (1) GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO (critical, NO_GO): UPSTREAM_DECISIONS records 2 upstream gate(s) returned NO_GO — BUY-03-COMPLIANCE-1 (COMP-RESID-001 UK residency violation, COMP-EXPORT-002 export control pending) and BUY-04-SECURITY-1 (SEC-NET-001 private endpoints absent for Confidential data tier, SEC-VULN-001 CVE-2026-8000 Critical open); action RESOLVE_UPSTREAM_NO_GO (Project Manager). The if/elif chain means the legal SUSPENSION (BUY-02) and IT REWORK (BUY-05) are shadowed by the NO_GO branch and do not add separate findings. (2) GEN-STRAT-001 (high, SUSPENSION): strategic_alignment="weak", corroborated by COMMITTEE_BRIEFING and BUSINESS_CASE; action OBTAIN_STRATEGIC_ARBITRATION (Sponsor). All other predicates fail to trigger: budget_requested_eur 7,000,000 ≤ budget_approved_eur 7,700,000 (GEN-BUDGET-001 not triggered; corroborated by authoritative BUDGET_APPROVAL status APPROVED, approver CFO Office); roi 0.344 ≥ 0.05 (GEN-BC-001 not triggered); phase is governance, not deployment_closure, so change_plan_status="missing" does not trigger GEN-BENEFITS-001 (corroborated by BENEFITS_PLAN declaring change plan missing with owner Marc Dubois-12002-BEN). Highest-severity disposition is NO_GO from the critical upstream finding. Authorization is required for NO_GO; the active standing mandate MANDATE-063d5e61-7a26-56ed-9b60-ce8a84676572-BUY-06-GENERAL-1 (Thomas Haddad-12002-RO) is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings" and cannot cover GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO (risk_acceptance_allowed=false); the attempted conditional approval covering only GEN-STRAT-001 was rejected ("All open findings must be covered"), so no conditional approval is recorded and the gate is blocked pending resolution of the two upstream NO_GO gates and sponsor strategic arbitration. Note: authoritative PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT is UNAVAILABLE (age 91d); a request was recorded and the submitted-state response confirms the snapshot values, so GEN-STRAT-001 is supported on the submitted snapshot. Proposed actions are not completed remediation.
